speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Penny with a new guy, tres awkward.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: It wasn't awkward. It wasn't fun. Besides, what's the big deal, we dated, we stopped dating, and now we're both moving on.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: By moving on, do you mean, she's going out with other men and you spent the afternoon making fifteenth century soap with Wolowitz?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That was not fifteenth century soap, my God those people need to learn you can't just put" ye olde" in front of anything and expect to get away with it.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Can we please just go in, my chain mail is stuck in my underwear.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're wearing modern underwear?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Relatively modern. Why, what are you wearing?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I fashioned historically accurate undergarments out of linen.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: You went out and bought linen?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Don't be silly, I borrowed one of your pillow cases.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Borrowed?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: You know what, I'm happy that Penny's moving on. It gives me the freedom to move on myself.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Are you saying that you've been holding back?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Of course. Out of respect.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: So, how do you explain the ten years before Penny?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Who were you respecting then?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What? I've dated plenty of women. There was Joyce Kim, Leslie Winkle.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Notify the editors of the Oxford English Dictionary, the word plenty has been redefined to mean two.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Uh,

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: what about that girl last year at Comic-con? Why not?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Doesn't count. What happens in costume at Comic-con, stays at Comic-con.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You're only saying that because of what happened to you.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What happened to you?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: N-n-n-nothing happened to me.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: It wasn't your fault, Raj, he was dressed as a green Orion slave girl.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: H-h-h-how did we get on me, we were mocking Leonard for not moving on. Dude, you have totally not moved on.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Yes I have, it's just a matter of actually making a date with someone. Well, there's Joyce Kim, but she defected back to North Korea so it's a little geographically undesireable.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Like who?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: What about Leslie Winkle.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh no.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Why?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Her research methodology is sloppy, she's unjustifiably arrogant about loop quantum gravity, and to make matters worse she's often mean to me.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I think she's smoking hot.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I'd hit that.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You'd hit particulate soil on a colloidal suspension. Mud.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Look, I like Leslie, but she's not interested in dating as much as using men as tools for stress release.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Yeah, so, be a tool. Go get yourself a little rebound stress release.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Technically it would only be rebound if he and Penny had actually engaged in physical intimacy.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You mean like you and Richard the slave girl?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I bought him dinner and we kissed once, that was it. And he told me his name was Kimberley!
